_about: The coast biome's brief as data (Claude C, lane C, 21 Oct): what the shared kit needs to paint a coast, written before the kit exists (rules-system.md 2 and 4, to-all-kit-freeze). Palette intent names house ramps (art/house-palette.json) and tones 0 (darkest) to 5 (lightest), never RGB. Edge sets name the cliff core's EDGE_SETS or are marked proposed. Plants and dressing follow to-all-clean (calm fields, clumped, no speckle) and to-all-volume (masses with depth, form shading, vegetation on rims and feet). Status 'brief': Claude A turns it into the kit's biome file at the kit cut and pins a kit version; until then numbers here are intent, not measured. Its own biome, not a variant of the kit's meadow (scripts/art/biomes/meadow.json, meadow@1, #215): the cliff core's coast edge set and the sea are what no meadow parameter reaches, so it shares the kit's engine (palette codes, shadow, lawn measure for its turf) and supplies its own sheets, edges and water. The kit renders at density 3 now (to-all-godot-1080); every size here is in world px.
references: Compare at the same character height with Eastward's coast and harbour screens (edges and the soft grid: Eastward only, Matt 21 Oct 09:23) and Sea of Stars' water (calm planes, depth bands, ripple strokes). Never commit their screenshots.

sand.note: dry upper beach in one calm tone with broad blotches of the warm sibling; damp sand below the wrack line a tone down; footprints and ripple crests are the only marks

black_sand.note: the isles and the ash coast: weathered basalt, warmer than the rock it came from, a cool sibling where wet; glints are white shell, never pure tone 5 of basalt

shingle.note: pebbles in packed rounded clumps, sorted small at the water to big at the storm ridge; never single-pixel stones

sea_turf.note: short salt-pruned turf, cooler and paler than the valley's meadow; drifts of thrift (berry 4) and sea campion (snow 4) in clumps

sea_cliff_rock.note: the cliff core's coast bands: pale bedded sandstone slabs on a dark basalt foot (EDGE_SETS.coast)

basalt_rock.note: the isles' faces and the cove's arm: columns and rounded boulders, upper-left planes lit two tones over the body, orange lichen (brass 3) above the tide only

shallow_water.note: over sand the floor shows through a tone down; the lagoon's calm plane

shelf_water.note: teal over the shelf, its band's edge wandering along the shore

deep_water.note: deep blue beyond the shelf; at night the sea is the darkest field on screen

foam.note: surf and lace only; foam is the one place tone 5 runs in lines

timber_works.note: piers, boats and posts silvered by salt: the cool sibling above the tide, the warm body where tarred

iron_works.note: rings, bollards and ladders; a rust run (brass 2) down the stone under them

ground._about: Ground recipes by kind: a body family, one or two siblings in broad soft blotches (2 to 3 tones apart at most, rules-system 'calm'), and dressing in clumps placed by rule. Shares are of the kind's area.

bands: wrack line (weed, sticks, shells along the shore)

dressing: marram thick on hummocks thinning into bare sand
wind ripples in short broken crests across the wind
outcrops of the cliff's rock with tufts in the cracks

quay.material: granite setts in courses, worn paler where feet go

dressing: ferns and monstera along path edges
roots across paths at a few points
rainforest_floor.note: variant isles: the forest floor on the raised ash, under a canopy that casts broad two-tone shade

plants.where: dunes and the back of beaches
plants.note: blades fan from a dark heart, lit west; the sand scooped a tone down in its lee
a low needle cushion, flowers in pairs on top
dark spiny dome lit upper west, yellow flowers in pairs on the lit side, a dark skirt

plants.where: the wrack line, rock feet, pier piles

plants.note: variant isles; groups of 2 or 3 leaning seaward

plants.where: isles: low shrub at the sand's edge
isles: the rainforest floor along paths

tiers.note: south faces only; tiers' masses step in and out by whole cells (to-all-volume 1); outlines on the cell grid with rounded corners (eastward-edges 1.6)

coast.where: sea cliffs and coastal tier faces on land
coast.shapes: pale bedded sandstone slabs on a dark basalt foot under a thin turf lip; stony foot with wrack; rock stair

coast_isle.where: the isles' tier faces between rainforest and shore
coast_isle.shapes: ash banks over basalt columns: rounded basalt heads in the face, roots and ferns hanging from a soft forest-floor lip, a foot of black grit and fern; stairs of basalt blocks or timber under the forest
coast_isle.differs_from_coast: darker, columnar, vegetated lip (the rainforest overhangs), no sandstone bands

sea_wall.shapes: dressed blocks 6 high in broken bond, a coping of long stones lit along its top, wet a tone down and weeded below the tide, rings, a ladder in a recess

shore_beach.shapes: swash: a pale broken foam line, damp sand a tone down behind it, no outline (a flat edge, not a height change)

shore_rock.shapes: a dark wet ring outside the rock, a broken white line and a second line of lace a few px out

water.sea: one calm plane in depth bands lying along the shore: shallow lagoon over sand, teal over the shelf, deep blue beyond; band edges wander by a cell, not by pixels
water.ripples: short strokes 3 to 6 px across the swell, lit a tone up with a tone down under; sparse, clumped where light catches, none in the deep band
water.surf: per shore kind, as the edge sets above; breakers only on the reef's seaward side
water.rock_pools: organic hollows in the platform: a shaded north rim, a lit south lip, clear water a tone over the floor, weed fronds
water.falls_into_sea: the cliff core's neutral fall; its plunge into the sea churns white for a cell then calms
water.motion: flow frames move a pixel one tone along its own ramp (never a new colour); finite and off when the screen is inactive or motion is reduced

proposed.lagoon_hamlet: a hamlet yard: a packing shed's door, fruit crates, a hammock between two palms, a water butt
proposed.turtle_beach: the turtle beach kept clear: a ring of shells round a nest, a warden's tally post
proposed.quay_corner: a quay's working corner: bollard, coil, fish boxes, a net heap, a ring in the wall (variant harbour)
proposed.cliff_lookout: a bench on the cliff top in the lee of gorse, a coastguard post, a lifebuoy (variant cliff_coast)

night: a lit window or quay lamp as the warm point
phosphorescence: a few tone-5 lagoon glints in the swash, finite (isles only)
ambience.light: upper-left sun; cast shadows two tones down on sand, one on water

transitions._about: This biome's side of each meeting in the block-out, for Claude G's scripts/art/biomes/transitions.json: a shared middle terrain both sides blend into, or a transition edge set.

meadow.middle: sea turf thinning into meadow over 160 px, marram and thrift giving way to clover

highland.middle: shingle and scree: the cliff's rock falling to the beach
highland.where: the massif's south foot if it reaches the sea (claude-f, claude-g)

moor.middle: sea turf into heather over a cell band of short grass

city.edge: sea_wall: the quay is the seam; setts on top, the sea below

river.middle: mud and saltmarsh: samphire and cordgrass clumps on grey mud, channels on the grid

ash.middle: black sand: the ash coast's beaches are the coast's black sand variant

rainforest.middle: the isles' sand into forest floor under a fringe of palms and sea grape, 64 to 120 px
rainforest.where: Tidebloom Isles (claude-c), inside the coast biome as variant isles

variants._about: Not separate biomes: the same families and edge sets with their own ground mix and plants. A variant that needs its own edge shapes names a proposed edge set above.

ash_coast.note: young lava where it meets the sea is the ash biome's

needs_from_kit._about: Techniques the coast needs that the meadow golden scene does not show (to-all-kit-215: sent to claude-a as c-to-a-isle-techniques); each goes into scripts/art/native once, for everyone. Ports name the frozen #162 function in kit-ports-c.md.
water: the sea as one plane in depth bands along the shore with sparse ripple strokes (port sea, ripples)
flow as one tone along its own ramp (port flow_frames)
a churned plunge pool at a fall's foot; a stream fanning out over a beach
the lagoon: the shallow band over sand
edges: shore_beach: swash, damp sand behind it (port surf)
shore_rock: a dark wet ring and lace, breakers on a reef (port surf, breakers)
coast_isle: basalt faces under a forest-floor lip, roots and ferns hanging, a black-grit foot
the in-water foot rule for any face: wet tone, weed, barnacles, salt line (port sea_foot)
sea_wall for harbours (port masonry, ladder, ring)
ground: sand sheets: beach bands (dry, wrack line, damp, swash), black sand on basalt, wind ripples, a trail trough in sand (port beach, trail)
sea turf with thrift and campion clumps
rainforest floor: loam with leaf-litter clumps under broad canopy shade
shingle and the shingle-to-sand blend (port shingle, grade)
plants: coconut palm, pandanus, tree fern and monstera/banana masters in the leaf-stamp style
sea grape, marram and gorse clumps
the giant tree with buttress roots (a landmark)
built: a timber pier on piles; a boathouse over the water; a slipway (port pier, slipway)
a basalt-block stair and a timber stair
a thatched rain shelter; a packing shed
landmarks: sea stack, sea cave mouth, basalt columns, crater lip
night: a pier lamp; phosphorescence in the swash (finite, off under reduced motion)
